authorization.request: Create a separate production-loop activation gate document and split activation into one-shot canary -> bounded N supervised run -> limited cron.

why: cron adds repeated execution and overlap risk
optimizer adds drift and Goodhart risk
continuous loop adds compounded failure amplification
external PR automation or auto-merge would turn local failures into externally visible state changes

stage_model.purpose: Record production activation criteria without enabling anything.
Run exactly one production-like pipeline canary under manual invocation and strict side-effect containment.
entry_requirements: explicit approval naming canary invocation method, timeout, budget, model/provider allowlist, and delivery target
clean worktree or declared dirty-scope waiver
concurrency lock path defined and verified absent before start
kill switch command documented before run
no auto-merge/deploy and no active runtime mutation
required_outputs: budget ledger if network/model calls are approved
pass_to_next_stage_only_if: scheduler decision is PASS_NO_ACTION or REVIEW_REQUIRED_WITHOUT_ACTION
optimizer output, if any, remains candidate-only and reviewed
Sunwoo explicitly approves G2 after reviewing G1 packet

stage_model.purpose: Run a small finite series under supervision to test repeatability, overlap controls, and evidence quality before cron.
entry_requirements: explicit N, schedule window, budget cap, and supervision owner approved
run ledger and idempotency key strategy defined
pass_to_next_stage_only_if: all N runs produce parseable evidence packets
no repeated REVIEW_REQUIRED of the same class without documented fix or waiver

stage_model.purpose: Enable a narrowly scoped expiring cron after G1/G2 evidence proves bounded behavior.
entry_requirements: cron expression, timezone, expiry date, max fire count, and delivery target approved
cron job prompt/script is self-contained and fail-closed
alert thresholds and silence-on-no-action semantics documented
state/watermark storage path allowed and bounded
pass_to_next_stage_only_if: cron fires only within approved schedule
no duplicate jobs or overlapping runs
no unexpected writes or network calls
review packets remain honest and fail-closed
manual review confirms value before any broader production loop

global_hard_blocks: active Hermes runtime/config/skill/memory mutation without a dedicated apply gate
optimizer writes directly to production artifacts
reported PASS when metric/scheduler gates require triage
network or paid benchmark calls without explicit budget approval

acceptance_criteria.name: stage_separation
acceptance_criteria.requirement: G1, G2, and G3 require separate approval and cannot be collapsed into one enablement.

acceptance_criteria.name: bounded_execution
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Each stage defines repeat count, timeout, lock, write roots, budget, and kill-switch behavior before execution.

acceptance_criteria.name: candidate_only_optimizer
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Optimizer output remains candidate-only until human-reviewed; no direct production mutation.

acceptance_criteria.name: cron_expiry_and_lock
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Limited cron has an expiry/max-fire count and skip-if-running concurrency policy.

acceptance_criteria.name: reviewable_evidence
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Every run produces JSON/Markdown evidence, side-effect ledger, and fail-closed status.

acceptance_criteria.name: no_auto_merge_deploy
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Human review/merge remains mandatory; deployment remains out of scope.

recommended_next_action: Prepare a G1 one-shot canary approval packet; do not enable cron or optimizer until that packet is explicitly approved.
